description: Reconstruction meets the same condition-before-tag order on a competing route. The $ condition fails before a tag query can reach its empty split delimiter, so the check passes (engine §4, §7.7, §10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a (A [+T])
%rule b (A [+T] [+T])
%rule c (A x)
%rule x T :: $.tokens-after-first.tags(migration-fault) %conditions $.source-text = "q"

%rule migration-fault ε | {_} %conditions "x" ∈ $.value.split($.value)
